name: SCU STEM Scholarship
summary: $27,000 over three years for 2026 Year 12 graduates of listed regional high schools starting a full-time STEM degree at SCU.
who: Completed Year 12 in 2026 at one of the listed regional high schools on the Coffs Coast, Gold Coast or Northern Rivers.
Australian citizen or permanent resident in a Commonwealth supported place.
Starting full-time study in Term 1, 2027 in a listed STEM degree or approved pathway.
how: No application. All eligible students who receive a STEM offer get it.
catches: Can't be held with another SCU-funded scholarship.

evidence.quote: Have completed Year 12 in 2026 at one of these identified regional High Schools.
